comments.text:
I wish I would've come across this video so much sooner after doing HOURS of research. I've looked up numerous videos & none broke it down like this. It's my first time applying & the USPTO site is not exactly beginner friendly lol. It was actually very overwhelming to navigate, but this step by step was very informative & thoroughly descriptive so thank-you for showing everything. I do have a question though... when I add the diagrams in the application description, do they have to be on their own separate page from the word explanations, or can I have the text wrap around it or in paragraphs above/below them? And can I make a list in figurative & numerological order explaining each number label? 

Ps. I'm also from Chicago! About 40 mins out, but I live on 124 Fake Street 😅🤣😂 lmao but fr im by Chicago. lol anyways thanks for the help and tyia!
